messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — Kestrel Labs dedicated pool bring-up rehearsal scheduled 2026-03-22 15:00 UTC. Objective: validate committed quota, autoscale behavior, and run a 30m load test. Need owners for load script, autoscaler config, and CSM renewal-risk note. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-bringup

Ben: I can own the autoscaler config. Current proposal: target_utilization=60%, scale_up at 80% (sustained 90s), scale_down at 30% (cooldown 300s). Is GPU mem tracking required or do we stick to CPU for this customer?

Diego: I’ll take the load script and execution. Planning to reuse the synthetic chat profile from last month (conversation mix + token length distribution). Will post the vegeta script here. Need a warm-up phase to prime KV cache and model lenses (~10m).

Lina: I’ll handle renewal-risk capture and enablement coordination. I’ll schedule the customer-facing walkthrough (45m) and the internal post-mortem. Also prepping the feedback form.

Aisha: Thanks. SLO gates for the rehearsal: p95 latency < 800ms, error rate < 1% for the committed pool under target load. If p95 > 1200ms for >2m we trigger fallback. Ben — please draft rollback/fallback (hosted-model variant + region shift) and post here.

Diego: Posting load command (dry-run pattern):

```bash
# generate targets file for vegeta
cat > targets.txt <<EOF
POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"kestrel-7b","input":"<chat-payload>"}
EOF

vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report > vegeta-report-$(date +%s).txt
```

Diego: Warmup plan: 10m low-rate (20 rps) to populate prefix cache + 5m step to 100 rps, then steady-state 200 rps for 30m. Tag runs with run_id=kestrel-rehearsal-20260322.

Ben: Autoscaler HPA snippet (Kubernetes/HPA-ish example):

```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: kestrel-infer-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: kestrel-infer
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 12
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 60
```

Ben: I’ll also prepare a policy in router: if p95 > 1200ms for >120s, shift 30% traffic to fallback-hosted region-b and notify oncall.

Lina: Enablement notes: walkthrough agenda + docs link will go to the customer — intro (5m), SLA review (10m), demo + priming (15m), Q&A (15m). Post-go-live: 1-week and 1-month check-ins to record feedback + renewal touchpoint. Feedback form: https://forms.redwood.example/kestrel-rehearsal

Aisha: Schedule: internal dry-run in staging today 09:00 PT; production rehearsal 2026-03-22 15:00 UTC. Please confirm availability. We’ll tag @oncall during the prod rehearsal. 

deploy-bot: Event created — "Kestrel bring-up rehearsal" 2026-03-22 15:00 UTC. Attendees: Aisha, Ben, Diego, Lina, oncall. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/abc123

Ben: Quota check: quota_id=kb-879 applied to dedicated pool (verified in console by me at 2026-03-20T16:10Z). I also pre-seeded a minimal priming cache on one node.

Diego: Load script (snippet) — sample JSON payload for generator: 

```json
{
  "model": "kestrel-7b",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following text..."}],
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```

Diego: I’ll push full targets.txt and vegeta-report after the staging dry-run.

Aisha: Ops notes: write logs & prometheus snapshots to s3://redwood-kestrel/rehearsals/2026-03-22/ with filename run_id + timestamp. Please include run metadata: run_id, operator, script_version, commit_sha. Lina: mark renewal_risk field in the account doc (low/med/high) after rehearsal — default to "medium" until we see p95 numbers.

Lina::+1: I’ll default to medium and update post-rehearsal. I’ll also capture points for the renewal playbook if we see poor perf.

Ben::thumbsup: I’m available for both runs. Will post rollback commands and router policy in the thread within 2h.

Diego::eyes: Will post staging results by EOD. If anyone needs the raw targets/samples earlier ping me.

Aisha::raised_hands: Nice — thanks all. Let’s keep this thread for operational notes only; customer convo in the meeting.
